meta.name: Match new property listings to buyer leads with Gemini, Gmail and Sheets

name: AI Property Matcher — Match Buyer Leads to Active Listings Automatically

options.systemMessage:
You are a real estate buyer matching assistant. A new property listing has come onto the market. Score each buyer lead's fit and draft personalized emails for good matches.

SCORING:
- Strong Match: Budget fits well, property type matches, location aligns, timeline active — contact immediately
- Possible Match: Most criteria fit, one area uncertain or slightly off — worth contacting
- Poor Match: Two or more criteria misaligned — skip

EMAIL RULES (Strong Match and Possible Match only):
- 2–3 sentences body maximum
- Reference the lead's specific preferences naturally
- Sound like the agent personally thought of them
- Never mention AI or automation
- Never say "matches your criteria" — be conversational
- Format: greeting line \n\n body paragraph

For Poor Match — set email_subject and email_body to null.

Output ONLY a valid JSON array, one object per lead, same order as input. No preamble, no markdown:
[{
  "leadId": "value",
  "leadName": "value",
  "matchScore": "Strong Match|Possible Match|Poor Match",
  "matchReason": "one sentence",
  "email_subject": "subject or null",
  "email_body": "Hi {name},\n\nBody. or null"
}]

parameters.content:
## AI Property Matcher — Match Buyer Leads to Listings

Every agent has buyer leads sitting in a database waiting for the right property. When a new listing hits the market, most agents either manually scan their CRM — or miss the match entirely. This workflow does it automatically.

When a new listing arrives via webhook, AI scans your entire buyer lead database, scores every lead against the listing across budget, location, property type, and timeline, and sends personalized match emails to the top 5 buyers — all within 60 seconds. Hot matches also trigger a Facebook Page post and Slack alert. Every match logs to a permanent history sheet.

One match converted to a sale pays back this template hundreds of times over.

### Requirements
- **Gmail** OAuth2 — match emails + agent notification
- **Gemini** API key — candidate scoring + email drafting
- **Google Sheets** OAuth2 — buyer database + match history
- **Slack** OAuth2 — optional Hot match alerts
- **WhatsApp Business Cloud** — optional match messages
- **Meta Page Access Token** — optional Facebook Page post

### Setup
1. Connect **Gmail**, **Gemini**, and **Google Sheets** credentials.
2. Copy the *Buyer Lead Database* and *Property Match History* sheet templates and link them to the Sheets nodes.
3. Populate your Buyer Lead Database — see the Buyer Database sticky for options.
4. Update **AGENT_EMAIL**, **CALENDLY_USERNAME**, and **CALENDLY_EVENT_SLUG** in the Normalize Listing Details Code node.
5. **Slack** is optional — connect your credential and set the channel name.
6. **WhatsApp** and **Facebook Page post** are optional — leave disconnected if not using.

### Customization
- Change MAX_MATCHES (default 5) in Normalize node.
- Change DAYS_SINCE_CONTACT (default 14) to adjust the re-contact cooldown window.
- Edit the Gemini prompt to adjust scoring criteria for your market.

## Buyer Lead Database

The matcher reads from your Buyer Lead Database Google Sheet. Only leads marked **Active = TRUE** are scanned per run. Set Active = FALSE to pause a lead without deleting them.

**How to populate your database:**
**Option 1 — Manual entry**
Add buyer leads directly to the Google Sheet using the column structure from the sheet template provided. This is the simplest approach for agents with an existing lead list to migrate.
**Option 2 — QualMatic Facebook Lead Ads Template**
If you run Facebook ads to capture buyer leads, pair this template with the QualMatic Facebook Lead Ads to AI-Qualified Follow-Up template (link below). Add one Google Sheets Append step to that workflow to automatically write every qualified Facebook buyer lead into this Buyer Lead Database — creating a fully automated pipeline from Facebook ad → qualification → matching.
[Facebook Lead Ads to AI-Qualified Follow-Up →](https://n8n.io/workflows/17258-qualify-facebook-lead-ads-and-send-follow-ups-with-gemini-gmail-and-sheets/)

## Webhook: New Listing Received
Fires when a new property listing is submitted via POST request from any source manually, from a competitor monitor workflow, or from any MLS webhook. See the submission docs for the required payload field names and format.

## Normalize Listing Details
Maps the incoming listing payload to clean named fields and sets all workflow configuration values in one place. Update AGENT_EMAIL, CALENDLY_USERNAME, MAX_MATCHES, and DAYS_SINCE_CONTACT here before going live.

## Score Candidates & Draft Emails
A two-stage matching process keeps the workflow fast and rate-limit-safe.

Stage 1 (Code): Hard filter by budget range, property type, and contact cooldown — instant, no API calls.

Stage 2 (Gemini): One AI call scores all filtered candidates holistically and drafts a personalized email for each Strong Match and Possible Match.

Poor Match leads are filtered out — only buyers with a genuine fit receive an email.

## Match Emails, WhatsApp & Booking Link
Each matched buyer receives a personalized email referencing their specific preferences — not a generic blast. The email includes property details, a listing link, and a Calendly booking link so buyers can schedule a viewing instantly. WhatsApp message fires additionally if the lead has a phone number on file and WhatsApp node is connected. Last Contacted date updates after each send to enforce the re-contact cooldown window.

## Agent Summary & Alerts
After all match emails are sent, the agent receives one summary email listing every buyer contacted, their match score, and the reason for the match. When 2 or more Strong Matches are found, an optional Facebook Page post publishes a property spotlight automatically. Slack fires alongside the agent email for Hot matches. Every match logs permanently to the Property Match History sheet — building an intelligence record of which listings generated buyer interest over time.

## WhatsApp is Optional
This node only fires for leads with a phone number on file. Connect your WhatsApp Business Cloud credential and update your Phone Number ID before enabling. Leave disconnected if not using WhatsApp.

## Facebook Page Post Setup Required
Before enabling this node:
1. Replace YOUR_META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN in the Authorization header with your real Page token.
2. Replace YOUR_PAGE_ID in the URL with your Page ID.
3. Connect this node from "Strong Matches Threshold Met?"

To get your Page Access Token:
Meta Developer App → Tools → Graph API Explorer → select your Page → Generate Access Token.

Disconnect if not using Facebook posting.
